description: FastAPI router implementation for bug tracking, including endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting bugs, and managing comments, with permission checks, notifications, and activity logging.

classes.name: BugResponse
classes.description: Schema representing detailed bug information with related project and user data.

classes.name: BugCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new bug report.

classes.name: BugUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating existing bug details.

classes.name: BugComment
classes.description: Schema representing a bug comment with user info.

classes.name: BugCommentCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new comment on a bug.

classes.name: UserResponse
classes.description: Schema representing the current authenticated user.
